name: hestrum-docgen
description: Hestrum DocGen: quotations, invoices, receipts, credit notes and waybills. Built to the Expert Prompt Playbook v6.0.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --erasableSyntaxOnly --target es2022 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --allowImportingTsExtensions --skipLibCheck --types node src/money.ts src/money.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:money && npm run test:sql
